runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 12:05 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No promotion-grade unique LIVE item was added. New direct-company discovery surfaced Umbrel non-technical Customer Support as Remote, but the public detail does not prove Slovakia employment/contract eligibility, so locationEligibility remains unknown and it was not promoted. OnHires Customer Support Technician is Europe-remote but VPS/networking/sysadmin-heavy. Foxelli remains Slovakia-eligible remote but strong spoken English and specialist/sales requirements are mismatches. Upwork surfaced a fresh Worldwide WordPress Content Automation & Blog QA VA posted 10.9.2026 with training, but strong written English plus an ambiguous 6 USD fixed-price public budget make it unsuitable for automatic promotion. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 verifiable hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Application assessment effort cost
developmentChanges.reason: Estimate unpaid application effort from test tasks, AI/video interviews, portfolio preparation and multi-step assessments, then discount reply/application ROI for roles whose selection workload is disproportionate to realistic compensation and fit.

developmentChanges.title: ATS location-entitlement proof before remote promotion
developmentChanges.reason: When an ATS shows only generic Remote, require explicit hiring-country evidence from the canonical job, application metadata or employer location policy before assigning remote-ok. Keep otherwise strong jobs such as generic global support roles at locationEligibility unknown instead of assuming Slovakia eligibility.
